identity.notes: The official site and officially linked Toast store agree on address and telephone.

sources.excerpt: Official site identifies Los Cuates at 1116 King St, Alexandria, VA 22314, with phone (703) 548-2918.
Official reservations page repeats the 1116 King St Alexandria storefront and 703-548-2918.
Official menu selector exposes eight Alexandria menu surfaces. The catalog has item names, descriptions, prices, and modifiers, but no formal allergen matrix or cross-contact statement.
